_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Writing, tightening, evaluating, and repairing LLM prompts and reusable prompt templates for completion, agent…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "write a reusable prompt for an LLM to classify support tickets and return one JSON object"
cases.context: The agent has access to the prompt-craft skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is prompt-craft the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes prompt-craft as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against context-engineering, eval-driven-development, evaluation
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the prompt-craft workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore prompt-craft
Does not route to context-engineering, eval-driven-development, evaluation when the prompt-craft scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
